contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ VICTOR[IAE LAETAE PRINC PERP] ; D/ IMP CON[STANTINVS AVG]

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I, AD 306-337 (Reece period 16). Reverse legend reads VICTOR[IAE LAETAE PRINC PERP]. Reverse shows Two Victories holding shield, inscribed [VOT PR], above altar. Mint of Trier, AD 318-320. Obverse legend reads IMP CON[STANTINVS AVG]. Obverse shows an helmeted bust left. Reverse exergue reads: //STR (Trier). Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 1.87g,…
